subject: Post-call: SOC 2, audit logs & retention — summary and next steps
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Nasr <samira.nasr@financialcorp.com>, Amit Patel <amit.patel@financialcorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0500
Subject: Post-call: SOC 2, audit logs & retention — summary and next steps

Hi Samira / Amit —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we keep momentum with your security and procurement teams.

What we heard (pain & goals)
- Need evidence of SOC 2 Type II controls for data handling and change management (procurement checklist item 12).
- Audit log access + retention: you want read-enabled access for security ops and an export cadence; target retention window is 24 months in primary region, with the ability to archive 7+ years for legal holds.
- DPA redlines: your team flagged two clauses (data residency & subprocessors) that you want addressed up front.
- Pen test: you requested Redwood’s most recent pen-test report and our remediation timeline for any findings.

What Redwood will do (asks we took away)
1) Share our SOC 2 Type II summary + scope and underlying evidence locations (one-pager attached: redwood-soc2-onepager.pdf).
2) Provide a sample of audit logs (sanitized) and an export template (audit-logs-sample.csv).
3) Send our latest third-party penetration test report (redacted where necessary) and a short remediation register.
4) Circulate a draft DPA with our suggested redlines for your legal team to review (we’ll attach a redlined doc).
5) Offer a short follow-up call between your security team and our infosec lead to walk through any gaps and agree on access modalities.

Proposed next steps / timeline
- I’ll send the documents listed above by EOD Monday (Nov 30).
- Can we schedule a 30-minute security review on Tue, Dec 1 at 10:00 AM ET? Calendars: https://cal.example.com/evelyn/availability/nov30-10am
- Please confirm who from your InfoSec team will join (name + email).

Attachments referenced: redwood-soc2-onepager.pdf (pdf).

If I’ve missed anything from your side, call it out and I’ll update the notes.

Thanks —
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

From: Samira Nasr <samira.nasr@financialcorp.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amit Patel <amit.patel@financialcorp.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC 2, audit logs & retention — summary and next steps

Evelyn —

Appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side and we attached the initial checklist you asked for.

Clarifications / asks
- Data residency: production customer data must remain in us-east-1 for our use case; can Redwood confirm the exported archives can be stored in a separate encrypted archive region under our control?
- Retention windows: 24 months is our default, but legal is insisting we keep a mechanism for 7+ years for legal holds. Can you confirm any extra cost model for long-term archival?
- Audit log access: Security ops will want a read-only S3-export and daily pushes; is that possible via your existing export APIs or do we need a dedicated connector?

Attachments included:
- procurement-checklist-financialcorp-1128.pdf (our internal checklist)

We’d prefer the security call on Tue Dec 1, 10 AM ET. Rishi on your side should join if available.

Thanks,
Samira Nasr
Head of Information Security | FinancialCorp
samira.nasr@financialcorp.com | +1 (212) 555-0920

Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0500
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: SOC 2, audit logs & retention — Samira clarifications

Marissa / Rishi —

Bringing you both in after Samira’s reply. They confirmed Dec 1 10am ET for the security call and attached their procurement checklist. Key asks from the prospect:
- Data residency = us-east-1 + ability to archive under customer control
- 24 month active retention + mechanism for 7+ year legal holds (cost question)
- Read-only daily exports (S3) for audit logs
- DPA redlines needed for subprocessors and residency clauses

What I need from you:
- Marissa: can you confirm the commercial impact if they require archived logs beyond 24 months? High-level cost delta is fine for the procurement thread.
- Rishi: can you prepare a short packet for the call with our SOC 2 scope, the redacted pen-test (if allowed), and a short note on export capabilities + encryption? I’ve attached the procurement checklist they sent.

I’ll upload the materials to the deal and send them ahead by EOD Monday.

Evelyn

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:17:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call: SOC 2, audit logs & retention — Samira clarifications

Evelyn / Marissa —

Acknowledged. I’ll prepare the security packet and attach the following by EOD: SOC2-Type2-summary.pdf, pen-test-report-2025.zip (redacted), and a sanitized audit log sample (audit-logs-sample.csv).

Quick technical notes to include on the call:
- We support region-scoped tenants; production data for FinancialCorp can be pinned to us-east-1.
- Export/ingest: we have a daily push to S3 (read-only credentials) and an on-demand export API. I’ll document the API schema and the retention lifecycle options (hot 24 months, cold archive >7 years).
- Archival cost: estimate = base export + storage in cold tier; I’ll ask finance for a 3-year and 7-year delta and include an example price table.
- Pen-test: 2025 engagement was with a third-party QSA; redactions are required for client-specific vulnerabilities but we can provide the validated summary and remediation timeline.

I’ll also propose a 30-minute agenda for Tue Dec 1: 1) review SOC2 scope (10 min), 2) audit log export & retention options (10 min), 3) DPA redlines next steps (10 min).

Rishi Malhotra
Head of InfoSec | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
